title: Code and data for 'A Least-Squares Approach to Sample-Based Prior Elicitation'
description:
Reproduction package for the paper A Least-Squares Approach to Sample-Based Prior Elicitation (Yannik Pitcan).

Eight seeded Python scripts reproduce every figure and every reported number in the paper: the least-squares elicitation estimator for the normal location and beta shape families; the comparison against the sample-only maximum-likelihood baseline and the reporting-noise crossover; the design analysis and its degeneracy under purely multiplicative noise; the no-moments (Cauchy) case; joint estimation of the parameter and an unknown reporting scale; the multivariate (location-scale) case; the additive error floor and the resulting interior optimal designs; and a semi-synthetic calibration against eleven datasets of human risk-frequency judgments.

Includes the tidy risk-judgment dataset converted from Pachur (2024, https://osf.io/u4d7g) together with the script that regenerates it from source, the figure PDFs used in the paper, and pinned package versions.
